```{r}

# Represent it
  ggplot(mw, aes(x=`Tree Status`, group=`Stand ID`, fill=`Stand ID`)) +
    geom_bar( alpha=0.6, position = 'identity')

```


```{r}


# Ensure factors
mw <- mw %>%
  mutate(
    `Tree Status` = factor(`Tree Status`),
    `Stand ID` = factor(`Stand ID`)
  )

# Summarise counts & proportions
mw_prop <- mw %>%
  group_by(`Stand ID`, `Tree Status`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(`Stand ID`) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count))

# Plot proportional bars
p1 <- ggplot(mw_prop, aes(x = `Stand ID`, y = prop, fill = `Tree Status`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Tree Status by Stand",
    x = "Stand ID",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Tree Status"
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p1)

```



```{r}
mw_prop1 <- mw %>%
  group_by(`Stand ID`, `Damage Type Code`) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(`Stand ID`) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count, na.rm=TRUE)) 

mw_prop1 <- mw_prop1 %>% drop_na(`Damage Type Code`, `Stand ID`)


pc <- ggplot(mw_prop1, aes(x = `Stand ID`, y = prop, fill =`Damage Type Code`,)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Damage Code by Stand",
    x = "Stand ID",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Damage Code"
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(pc)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = mw %>% filter(`Tree Status` == "DE"),
  aes(x = `Stand ID`, fill = `Tree Status`)
) +
  geom_bar(stat="count", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Snag Occurence by Stand")+ 
    theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),  # Panel background color
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgray", size = 0.8), # Major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5, linetype = "dashed"), # Minor grid lines
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "aliceblue"))+#Full Background
  coord_flip()

```
